notes: Givaudan Flavors Corporation is the US flavours arm of Givaudan SA, whose corporate headquarters is Givaudan International SA in Vernier, Switzerland; group headcount is about 17,580. JobsOhio's December 2024 report ties the $3,000,000 Economic Development Grant commitment to a $127,250,000 Hamilton County project with 882 jobs retained and 220 created (https://www.jobsohio.com/files/reports/2024_annual_monthly_metrics.pdf).

Private Cincinnati medical-device maker (on-body drug infusion), operating in Evendale, West Chester and Franklin since 2010; JobsOhio's February 2023 report lists 193 jobs retained and 257 committed against a $124,000,000 investment, so several hundred employees at most. The LLC is the grant payee of Enable Injections, Inc.; no outside corporate owner was found, though it is venture-backed.

NP DWBA LLC is a single-purpose vehicle of NorthPoint Development, the Kansas City industrial developer building the First Flight Commerce Center next to the Dayton-Wright Brothers Airport (DWBA) in Miami Township, a $146,000,000 project begun in April 2024 (https://www.wdtn.com/news/local-news/new-146-million-commerce-center-begins-development-in-miami-township/); JobsOhio's own reports show NorthPoint Holdings spec-development (OSIP) grants in Montgomery, Butler and Lucas counties. NorthPoint publishes no headcount, so the bucket is a guess for a developer operating in 28 states.

JobsOhio's release calls Jamon Sellman a local Urbana developer; Sellman Enterprises LLC renovated the historic Willman Furniture building on Monument Square into nine loft apartments and the WillWork coworking space, the project behind the $800,000 Vibrant Community Grant recorded in October 2023 for Champaign County. Its business is owning and leasing the building, not operating in it.

GXO Logistics Supply Chain, Inc. is the US operating subsidiary of GXO Logistics, Inc. (NYSE: GXO), headquartered in Greenwich, Connecticut; the FY2024 10-K reports about 152,000 team members in 27 countries as of December 31, 2024. The grant matches a $35,600,000 Madison County warehouse with 200 jobs committed (JobsOhio, February 2024).

Off-price department store chain headquartered at 55 Scott Avenue, Morgantown, West Virginia, with more than 116 stores at the time of the grant and about 8,000 employees in 2023; Warburg Pincus has held the majority stake since 2016, with the Gabriel family retaining a minority. The money funded its 850,000 sq ft Springfield distribution center, so this is an operating retailer building its own facility.

Luvata's own site states that Mitsubishi Materials Corporation acquired Luvata in May 2017 and that Luvata is a group company of MMC, which reported 18,323 consolidated employees as of March 31, 2024; MMC is headquartered in Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo. Luvata Ohio runs the Delaware, Ohio copper plant behind a $12,000,000 project with 111 jobs retained (JobsOhio, March 2024).

Privately held metal roofing and siding maker incorporated in 1996, headquartered at 10 Enterprise Court, Lebanon, Pennsylvania, with plants in Lebanon PA, Howe IN, Orwell OH and Bridgton ME; the $250,000 Revitalization Grant funds its own new Preble County plant, a $23,500,000 project with 50 jobs committed, so this is a manufacturer building its own facility, not a developer. No headcount was published, so the bucket is inferred from four existing plants.

The recipient address, 444 Salomon Circle in Sparks, Nevada, is SNC's own headquarters, so the payee is the parent; SNC is owned by Fatih and Eren Ozmen and is described as having over 4,000 employees, with one infobox figure of 5,000 for 2022, which leaves it near the 5,000 line after the 2021 Sierra Space spin-off. The grants fund its aircraft maintenance and overhaul build-out at Dayton International Airport.

Victoriaville & Co., founded 1907 in Victoriaville, Quebec, is a fourth-generation family casket maker that says it employs hundreds of people in Canada, the United States and the United Kingdom, and is the third-largest hardwood casket manufacturer. Its US manufacturing entity opened a Cleveland plant in 2023, a $1,162,000 project with 100 jobs committed (JobsOhio, April 2023).

Betco makes cleaning chemicals and floor-care equipment and was founded in 1950 by Carl and Ann Betz of Toledo; its plant and head office are in Bowling Green, where JobsOhio's July 2024 report records 225 jobs retained and 20 created against a $20,000,000 investment. No company-wide headcount was published and no corporate owner was found, so the bucket rests on the retained-jobs floor and could reach the next bucket.

ProFusion makes flexible PVC film, industrial matting and Koroseal linings at Marietta (Washington County), where JobsOhio's April 2021 report lists 117 jobs retained and 19 created; the 990 address is an office in Fairlawn. Google News headlines from July and August 2020 (Smart Business Dealmakers, Plastics News) report that Peak Rock Capital sold ProFusion to a management group, so the owner during the grant years was management, not the PE firm (https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=%22ProFusion+Industries%22+Peak+Rock).

Grimco is a wholesale sign and graphics supply distributor whose own site describes more than 60 stocked locations across North America; the 990 address, 11745 Sappington Barracks Road in St. Louis, is its headquarters. JobsOhio's June 2021 report ties the $110,000 grant to a Summit County project with 33 jobs retained and 6 created. No headcount is published, so the bucket is inferred from the branch count.

GEALAN Window Systems Inc. is the US arm of GEALAN Fenster-Systeme GmbH of Oberkotzau, Germany, which has belonged to VEKA AG of Sendenhorst since 2014; GEALAN alone reports more than 1,700 employees and VEKA about 6,000. The grant funded its new US headquarters and distribution site in Licking County, a $720,000 project with 27 jobs committed (JobsOhio, February 2025).

OnQ Solutions is a retail display design, production and fulfillment company headquartered at 24540 Clawiter Road in Hayward, California; JobsOhio's March 2024 report shows a $100,000 Revitalization Grant for a Summit County project with 40 jobs retained and 27 created, and an Akron Beacon Journal headline from October 2024 places the new site at the former Chapel Hill Mall. No headcount was published, so the bucket is a guess above the Ohio floor.

Infoverity is a master-data-management consultancy founded in Dublin, Ohio in 2011 and is 100% employee-owned, with offices in Europe and Mexico; JobsOhio's April 2024 report lists 132 jobs retained and 65 committed for the Franklin County expansion. Employee ownership means there is no corporate parent above it.

JobsOhio's May 2024 report records a $75,000 Economic Development Grant for this Montgomery County advanced-manufacturing project with 32 jobs retained, 15 committed and a $241,744 investment, which puts it well under 100 employees. No company website or news coverage could be found for the Dayton firm at 2127 Troy Street; premieraerospace.com belongs to an unrelated Doral, Florida repair station, so the owner above the LLC is unknown.

JobsOhio's August 2024 report shows a $75,000 Workforce Grant for a Huron County advanced-manufacturing project with 24 jobs committed, no jobs retained and a $250,000 investment, and a Norwalk Reflector headline from September 2024 reads 'Norwalk nabs new business', so this is a small out-of-state firm opening its first Ohio plant. No working website was found for the Santa Cruz, California address, so the size is a guess from the small investment.

AMG Products makes metal gaskets, shims and spacers and is ISO 9001 certified, at 1375 Newark Road in Mount Vernon (Knox County); JobsOhio's October 2024 report records a $50,000 Small Business Grant with 15 jobs retained and 5 created. The Small Business Grant is limited to companies with annual revenue between $100,000 and $25 million.

Cincinnati inbound-marketing and HubSpot agency serving IT, manufacturing and construction clients; JobsOhio's January 2024 report records a $50,000 Inclusion Grant with 9 jobs retained, 6 created and a $27,800 investment. Inclusion and Small Business Grants are restricted to companies with revenue under $25 million.

JobsOhio's October 2024 report records a $50,000 Economic Development Grant for this Stark County energy-and-chemicals project with 15 jobs retained, 15 created and a $1,500,000 investment, which keeps it under 100 employees. No website, news story or filing could be tied to the Uniontown company; a Lake Township carwash-chemicals maker called Synergy Solutions matches the location and industry but the link is unconfirmed.

GBS Corp. of 7233 Freedom Avenue NW, North Canton, sells business technology, print and marketing services and states on its site that it is 100% employee-owned, so there is no parent above it; JobsOhio's July 2024 report lists 75 jobs retained, 20 created and a $4,200,000 investment for the Stark County project. The company does not publish a headcount, so the bucket rests on the retained-jobs figure plus its several offices.

JobsOhio's October 2024 report records a $50,000 Small Business Grant for this Montgomery County advanced-manufacturing project with 25 jobs retained, 10 created and a $4,500,000 investment, and the program is capped at companies with revenue under $25 million. No website or news coverage could be found for the Dayton company at 529 Hunter Avenue, so its ownership is unknown.

JobsOhio's December 2024 report records a $50,000 Small Business Grant for a Cuyahoga County energy-and-chemicals project with 3 jobs retained, 2 created and a $75,000 investment, and the program is capped at $25 million of revenue, so the company is small. The Schedule I address is a post office box in Canton, Mississippi; the only Qualico, Inc. website found is an unrelated Texas remodeling contractor, so nothing else about the company could be confirmed.

JobsOhio's September 2024 report records a $50,000 Small Business Grant for this Franklin County aerospace and aviation project with 17 jobs retained and 2 created, and the program is limited to companies with revenue between $100,000 and $25 million, so the firm is small. No website or news coverage was found for the Gahanna company at 465 Waterbury Court, so its ownership is unknown.

Veteran Hardened Steel does steel straightening, bar chamfering and centerless grinding at 896 E 70th Street in Cleveland, the address on Schedule I; JobsOhio's November 2024 report records a $50,000 Small Business Grant with 11 jobs retained, 2 created and a $57,850 investment. The grant program caps revenue at $25 million.

SURE Mechanical is a commercial HVAC and mechanical contractor in Cincinnati, part of a small group it calls SURE Group; JobsOhio's November 2020 report records a $50,000 Inclusion Grant with 28 jobs retained, 6 created and a $38,123 investment. It is a contractor providing services, not a developer of real estate.

SavKon is a service-disabled-veteran-owned and woman-owned renovation contractor in Columbus doing acoustic ceilings, demolition, drywall, flooring and framing; JobsOhio's December 2024 report records a $50,000 Small Business Grant with 2 jobs retained, 2 created and a $68,000 investment. It sells construction labor, so it is classed as an operating business rather than site development.

JobsOhio's March 2024 report records a $25,000 Inclusion Grant for this Hancock County healthcare project with 1 job retained, 1 created and a $20,000 investment, which makes it a one- or two-person practice in Findlay. No website or news coverage could be found for the company at 825 S Main Street.

Callies has made high-performance crankshafts, connecting rods and camshafts in Fostoria since 1989 and says it is headquartered there; JobsOhio's August 2023 report records a $25,000 Inclusion Grant with 100 jobs retained and 10 created, so it sits in the 100-499 bucket despite the small-business program.

DB Rediheat makes heated pizza and food-delivery bags and carriers in Cleveland; JobsOhio's July 2024 report records a $25,000 Small Business Grant with 16 jobs retained, 3 created and a $104,000 investment. The program caps revenue at $25 million.

JobsOhio's August 2024 report records a $25,000 Small Business Grant for this Sandusky County advanced-manufacturing project with 29 jobs retained and 4 created, and the program caps revenue at $25 million. The company's site at flowermfg.com renders only through JavaScript and returned no readable text, so nothing beyond the Fremont address could be confirmed.

JobsOhio's March 2023 report records a $25,000 Inclusion Grant for this Ottawa County advanced-manufacturing project with 3 jobs retained, 6 created and a $60,000 investment. A Google News headline from thebeacon.net in March 2023 names Lateral Gig as the Ottawa County Improvement Corporation's entrepreneur of the year, which fits a very small Oak Harbor firm; the company's own site could not be reached.

Oberlin Food Hub says on its own site that it was founded in 2017 and is a nonprofit organization aggregating and distributing food from regional farmers, so it is classed as a nonprofit rather than a business; JobsOhio's December 2024 report records a $25,000 Small Business Grant with 4 jobs retained and 2 created. A ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer search returned no record for the name, so it does not appear in the IRS master file.

R.S. Imprints decorates apparel with direct-to-film transfers and screen printing in Newton Falls; JobsOhio's February 2025 report records a $25,000 Small Business Grant with 11 jobs retained, 3 created and a $321,846 investment. The program caps revenue at $25 million.

Sewah Studios casts the metal historical markers used by states and historical societies and has worked in Marietta for decades; JobsOhio's November 2023 report records a $25,000 Inclusion Grant with 25 jobs retained, 5 created and a $497,849 investment. Its own site refused automated requests, so the description rests on Google News headlines from the Marietta Times, WTAP and Ohio Magazine (https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=%22Sewah+Studios%22+Marietta).

Warren Printing does commercial paper and apparel printing in Ottawa (Putnam County); JobsOhio's October 2024 report records a $25,000 Small Business Grant with 2 jobs retained, 1 created and a $75,406 investment. The program caps revenue at $25 million.

WSAZ reported in October 2024 that Brent Buckley's Flatrock Butcher Block, a meat processing plant in Gallia County, won $25,000 from JobsOhio and more than $300,000 from the Ohio Department of Development to expand; JobsOhio's September 2024 report lists 2 jobs retained, 2 created and a $130,000 investment. It is a farm-service butcher shop, so well under 100 employees.

JobsOhio's April 2025 report records a $25,000 Small Business Grant for this Clermont County food and agribusiness project with no jobs retained, 2 created and an $11,200 investment, which makes it a start-up farm on State Route 133 in Batavia. No website or news coverage could be found for the company.
